content: structlog 26.1.0 is the production choice for FastAPI JSON logging: processor pipeline with structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars pulls per-request bound context (request_id, workspace_id, job_id) into every line automatically; JSONRenderer for prod, ConsoleRenderer for dev; stdlib ProcessorFormatter routes uvicorn's own loggers through the same pipeline. loguru is ergonomic but is a separate sink system that does not integrate with stdlib logging cleanly and has no contextvars-native binding, so uvicorn/httpx logs stay unstructured.
